title: Audio Management Unit Mounting Tray and Cooling Path Change in the Flight Compartment Rack
abstract: Change of the audio management unit mounting tray and its cooling path, after units in the upper rack position were found running hot and producing intermittent interphone dropouts on long ground stops.

sections.reason: Line stations reported intermittent loss of flight interphone and of the cabin call function during long turnarounds, always on aircraft whose audio management unit sat in the upper rack position and always after the aircraft had been on ground power for more than an hour. Bench testing of thirty-one returned units found no fault in twenty-eight of them. Thermal survey of the rack showed the upper position running eighteen degrees hotter than the lower one because the tray blanked the cooling path, and the unit was throttling its audio processing at that temperature rather than failing outright, which is why the fault never reproduced on the bench.
sections.description: The mounting tray D2350116486608 is replaced by a perforated tray that opens the cooling path under the unit, and the rack LU507538-19 is fitted with a revised lower guide so that the unit seats forty millimetres further forward and clears the rear bulkhead. The display unit GRA872629-19 in the same rack column is unaffected but its retaining screws AES832388-10 are replaced because the new tray flange is thinner. The audio control panel at FIN 8830RC is not changed. Work is in zones 211 and 214 through the flight compartment rack access, and the rack must be de-energised. The aircraft is not jacked and no harness is disturbed.
sections.effects: Mass reduction of 0.4 kilograms. No electrical load change. Fully interchangeable. The unit running temperature in the upper position falls by fourteen degrees, which removes the throttling behaviour entirely, and the no fault found rate on returned units is expected to drop from ninety per cent to below thirty. The removal and installation task and the parts figure require re-issue; no flight crew documentation is affected because the failure never produced a flight deck indication.
sections.embodiment_note: Retrofit only. No production cut-in was required because the line had moved to a different rack layout before the finding was raised. Embodiment is a two hour task at any line station with the aircraft on ground power removed.

type_data.production_impact: No cut-in required; later rack layout already opens the cooling path
